transcript:
The rename of RequestContext.requestId to traceId across its definition and consumers under src/ is complete.
Summary of Changes


src/context.ts:

Renamed RequestContext.requestId to traceId (readonly traceId: string).
Kept type alias export type ActiveContext = RequestContext;.
Removed requestId with no compatibility member retained.



src/context-factory.ts:

Updated createContext to initialize {traceId: value, userId}.
Updated forkContext to return a new context with {...context, traceId: context.traceId + '/' + suffix}, preserving immutability and the suffix delimiter.



src/logging.ts:

Updated destructuring from context to extract traceId (const {traceId, userId} = context;).
Maintained the wire/output key requestId (return {requestId: traceId, userId};).



src/middleware.ts:

Updated headers to populate the 'x-request-id' header with context.traceId.



src/jobs.ts:

Updated describeJob to assign trace: context.traceId.
Preserved Job.requestId mapping on the output key requestId: job.requestId and the audit label call audit: auditLabel(job.requestId).



src/response.ts:

Updated response to populate the requestId output key with context.traceId.



src/worker.ts & src/app.ts:

Kept unchanged as they propagate RequestContext cleanly through typed parameters and factory functions.



tests/regression.test.mjs:

Added regression test suite verifying:

End-to-end propagation through handle to all stages (context, headers, logs, body).
Absence of a requestId property on RequestContext instances.
Separation and preservation of the unrelated Job.requestId and audit identifier.
Immutability and suffix behavior of forkContext.
Direct unit execution of individual pipeline stages.
